title: Pocketwire Advance Tier Ladder — Review Thresholds and Entry Requirements
content:
Every Pocketwire Advance tier has a direct deposit requirement it must keep at the monthly review, an entry threshold a line must meet to move onto it, and a track record needed to move up from it.

## Keeping the tier

| Tier | Direct deposits in the previous calendar month (USD, at least) | Number of direct deposits in the previous calendar month (at least) | Consecutive reviews below the requirement tolerated before a downgrade |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 300.00 | 1 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 500.00 | 1 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 800.00 | 2 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 1200.00 | 2 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 1800.00 | 2 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 2500.00 | 2 | 2 |

The direct deposits counted are those into the linked Pocketwire Personal Account.

## Moving up from the tier

| Tier | Consecutive on-time repayments needed to move up one tier | Calendar days without any past-due period needed before an upgrade |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 2 | 90 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 3 | 90 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 4 | 90 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 5 | 120 |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 6 | 120 |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 6 | 180 |

## Entry thresholds

| Tier | Entry requirement |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | Linked personal account on Pocketwire Core or a higher plan, opened at least 60 days before the application, and direct deposits of at least 300.00 in the previous calendar month |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | Direct deposits of at least 500.00 in the previous calendar month |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | Direct deposits of at least 800.00 in the previous calendar month |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | Direct deposits of at least 1200.00 in the previous calendar month |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | Direct deposits of at least 1800.00 in the previous calendar month |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | Direct deposits of at least 2500.00 in the previous calendar month |

## Reading the ladder (hypothetical figures)

- A line on Pocketwire Advance Standard whose linked account received 850.00 from 2 direct deposits in the previous calendar month meets both parts of its tier's requirement; the same 850.00 from a single deposit falls short on the count.
- Direct deposits of 1200.00 in the previous calendar month meet the entry threshold of Pocketwire Advance Plus; 1199.99 does not.
